limitations: This closes architecture and dependency ownership only. It does not define final machine artifact bytes, a DSL, a public API, or a shipped interpreter.

Current Python Assent handlers still enforce review behavior. They remain comparison evidence until the independent Lean Review machine proof passes and the later hard cutover deletes them without fallback.
The PopulationPlan, GraphConstructionPlan, and CandidateValidationReceipt boundary is research-local design. It is not yet executable or a stable consumer contract.
The inquisitor rule is currently a mandatory review guard, not a syntax-aware detector over Python source.
An LLM may help author or correct ontology and machine inputs outside the deterministic kernel. It is not part of acceptance, replay, or compiler authority.
